title: prangos ferulacea subsp. carinata
intro: Prangos ferulacea subsp. carinata, commonly known as Indian sarsaparilla, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Indian subcontinent, for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Prangos ferulacea subsp. carinata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in managing various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
